description: Módulo admin de importação manual de planilhas (CSV/Excel) com validação em staging, upsert em prb_deliveries, histórico e disparo em background dos jobs de relatório existentes.

userStories.title: Migrations de lote, staging e auditoria
userStories.description: As a developer, I need prb_* tables for import batches and staging so validation can run without touching prb_deliveries.
acceptanceCriteria: Incremental migrations for prb_import_batches, prb_import_batch_items (staging), and import history/log fields with created_by/created_on/modified_by/modified_on/enabled where applicable
Audit tables and triggers in project prb_* pattern
Batch stores file metadata, status enum (uploaded|validating|validated_ok|validated_error|importing|imported|failed), counters and timings
Staging references batch_id and preserves spreadsheet row number for error messages
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Catálogo de filiais para validação de existência
userStories.description: As an admin, I want import to reject unknown branch codes and suggest registering the branch.
acceptanceCriteria: Branch source of truth: distinct non-empty branch from prb_users where profile='filial' and enabled=true
Empty or unknown branch produces per-row error and blocks the batch
Error message suggests registering the branch via Administração → Usuários (filial profile + Filial field)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: API de upload e criação de batch em staging
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to upload one spreadsheet so rows are staged for validation without writing deliveries.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin-only multipart upload endpoint; one file per request
Accept .csv, .xlsx, .xls; reject other types with clear 400
Reject empty/corrupt files and files over 20 MB or 100000 data rows; Excel validates expected sheet exists
Persist file under storage/imports (retention allowed, no auto-purge in this delivery); create batch + staging only — no prb_deliveries writes
Reuse CSV column mapping (limpeza COLUNAS_UTEIS / CsvDeliveryImportService patterns); Excel converts to same internal schema
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Serviço de validação completa do lote
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a full validation pass on staged data before any production update.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate endpoint/service reads staging only; does not modify prb_deliveries
Structure checks: required columns, unknown/duplicate columns, types
Data checks: dates, numbers, required empties, duplicate nro_entrega/remessa within sheet, unknown branch (US-002)
Each error stores line number + explicit Portuguese message
Batch counters and status updated to validated_ok or validated_error
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Tela Admin — Upload, validação e resultado
userStories.description: As an admin, I want an Importação de Dados screen with drag-and-drop and validation results for the two-step flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Menu Administração → Importação de Dados visible only to admin
UI: drag-and-drop, file picker, file metadata, Validar Planilha and Importar Dados buttons
Importar Dados disabled until validated_ok (zero errors)
After validation show totals and detailed error list
Visual identity matches existing Admin React
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Importação efetiva com upsert e transação
userStories.description: As an admin, I want confirmed import to upsert deliveries by remessa/nro_entrega using existing business rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Import endpoint accepts only validated_ok batches; otherwise 400/409
Staging maps to DeliveryRecord and upserts prb_deliveries by remessa_numero (same as CSV/API)
Reuse existing cleanup/macro pipeline as applicable on write
Single DB transaction for the batch; on error full rollback and status failed with log
Update inserted/updated counters and status imported
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Progresso da importação na UI
userStories.description: As an admin, I want progress feedback during import for large files.
acceptanceCriteria: During import UI shows progress bar with percent, processed and remaining (polling or equivalent)
On completion show summary: processed, updated, inserted, total time
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Histórico de importações
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a searchable history grid of past imports for audit.
acceptanceCriteria: Grid on same page: datetime, user, file, total, inserted, updated, errors, duration, status
Filters by date, user, file, status
Data from prb_import_* tables (not in-memory only)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Disparo automático dos jobs de relatório após importação
userStories.description: As an admin, I want filial and gerencial report jobs to run in background after successful manual import.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful imported status, trigger existing report_overdue_daily worker (both phases) in background — do not reimplement mail/HTML in the page
API import response is not blocked by report job runtime; trigger failures are logged on batch without rolling back deliveries
Manual post-import trigger bypasses --if-due window (e.g. --force) and is documented
Document Alternative 1 rationale (reuse jobs) in feature docs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Documentação do módulo de importação manual
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want docs covering the manual import flow, tables, validation and job trigger.
acceptanceCriteria: Update repo docs: upload→staging→validate→import flow, tables, validation rules, upsert, job trigger, supported spreadsheet model (CSV+Excel)
Include Mermaid flowchart of the process
Documentation complete
